$comment: P69 (lane `cs`, D-C-STDARG-VA-COPY-MISSING): C 7.16.1.2 `va_copy(dest, src)` makes `dest` a copy of `src` — the same position in the same argument list, each then advanced on its own. DSS had no `va_copy` at all (the name was an undeclared identifier), and <stdarg.h> defined none of the five names as a macro, so the portable `#ifdef va_copy` test took its fallback. Seven shapes; the exit code is a bitmask of the ones that broke: 1 a copy at va_start, 2 a copy MID-WALK taken through `__va_copy` where it exists, 4 doubles (the SysV floating-point cursor), 8 more integers than argument registers (the SysV overflow cursor), 16 a copy of a `va_list` PARAMETER (on SysV a pointer to the caller's tag: the TAG is copied, never the pointer, or walking the copy advances the source), 32 `#ifdef va_copy` after <stdarg.h>, 64 a copy INTO a `va_list` PARAMETER (the other side of 16: on SysV the copy fills the caller's tag the parameter points at, never the pointer; the caller passes a memset `va_list`, a determinate value on every ABI). MEASURED 2026-10-06 through `dssharness run probe-reference-cc`, this file with shape 64: gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 at -std=c17 -pedantic-errors and -std=c2x (run 20261006-233405-debb3677), mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 both modes (run 20261006-233447-6303e3fd), MSVC 19.51 /std:clatest and /std:c17 (run 20261006-233449-fe503d28) and Apple clang 21.0.0 for arm64-apple-darwin at both modes (run 20261006-233519-86d1cf5b) all exit 42; the six earlier shapes first measured 2026-09-30 (runs 20260930-233748-3ee35e9b, -233812-5ea652e3, -233816-2997350f). Every operand comes from argc. The release arm is REPORT-ONLY: its value is that the optimized pipeline keeps the copy and its source two objects (a forwarded load or a dead-store elimination across the copy would merge their cursors).
